katalog.markensatz: Curated models — pick one, fetch it, start it.
katalog.keine_kuratierten: No curated models for this kind yet — search above.
katalog.begleiter: Vision and speed module ride along automatically — matched to this exact build.
katalog.satz_gemma12: Same family, half the weight. The pick for 16 GB machines — tools, vision and the speed module included.
katalog.lang_gemma12: The same tool-calling family, at half the weight — the everyday pick for a 16 GB machine. Dense, sees images, and ships with its own speed module, fetched and matched automatically.
katalog.satz_bonsai: One bit per weight — a 27B brain in a 3.8 GB file. Unbeatable per gigabyte, thinks before it answers.
katalog.lang_bonsai: One bit per weight brings a 27B model down to a 3.8 GB file — unbeatable per gigabyte, and it thinks before it answers. Sees images, calls tools, and fits an 8 GB machine.
katalog.satz_exeguard: Our own guardian model — tiny, trained on the terminal's own tools.
katalog.lang_exeguard: Exe Guard Dynamic: our self-trained guardian model. It spots a failed step and suggests the one instruction that fixes it. (Final wording just before release.)
katalog.satz_exeturbo: Our small core model for weak machines — MoE, trained on the terminal.
katalog.lang_exeturbo: Exe Turbo S: our self-trained core model for machines with 6–8 GB of memory. It computes with only 1.5 of its 8.3 billion parameters per token and knows the terminal's tools and rules.
katalog.satz_cyberrealisticxl: Photoreal SDXL — skin, light and lens that hold up close. The go-to for realistic portraits and scenes.
katalog.satz_juggernautxl: A broad, dependable SDXL all-rounder: photoreal by default, but at home in most styles you ask of it.
katalog.satz_realisticvision: The small photoreal standard — SD 1.5, light on memory, and still strikingly real. A go-to base for realistic scenes.
katalog.satz_anythingv5: The classic anime SD 1.5 — clean lines, bright colour, and light enough for almost any machine.
katalog.satz_toonyou: Cartoon and stylised characters on SD 1.5 — soft shading, expressive faces, a small download.
katalog.satz_animaginexl: Anime at SDXL size — sharper detail and higher resolution than the SD 1.5 anime models, for a stronger machine.
katalog.satz_vae_sd15: The classic SD 1.5 VAE — the part that turns the model's internal numbers into real pixels. Cleaner colours and detail on models shipped without one.
katalog.satz_vae_sdxl: The fixed SDXL VAE that no longer overflows in fp16 — clean colours without the infamous black tiles.
katalog.satz_lora_lcm_sd15: The LCM accelerator for SD 1.5 — usable pictures in a handful of steps instead of twenty.
katalog.satz_lora_lcm_sdxl: The same LCM accelerator for SDXL — few steps, much faster.
katalog.satz_adetailer_face: Finds faces in the finished picture and repaints each one on its own — the big lever for clean portraits.
katalog.satz_mmproj_gemma: Vision for Gemma 4 31B — the projector that lets the language model see images. Lands in the model folder.
katalog.satz_mtp_gemma: The speed module for Gemma 4 31B — a small rider that guesses the next words and speeds up answers.
katalog.satz_zub_lora: A speed LoRA — usable pictures in a handful of steps instead of twenty.
katalog.satz_zub_vae: A VAE — turns the model's internal numbers into real pixels, for cleaner colours and detail.
katalog.satz_zub_adetailer: An ADetailer detector — finds faces, hands or people in the finished picture and sharpens each one.
katalog.satz_zub_mtp: A speed module (MTP) — rides alongside the language model and speeds up its answers. Lands in the model folder.
katalog.satz_zub_mmproj: Vision — the projector that lets a language model see images. Lands in the model folder.
katalog.satz_qwen36: The speed flagship — MoE with its tempo module built in, and eyes via the vision add-on.
katalog.lang_qwen36: A mixture-of-experts model: 35B on disk, 3B active per token, the tempo module baked into the file, a quarter-million tokens of context. The vision projector rides along with the download.
katalog.satz_qwencoder: The agent coder — built for tool calls, long runs and big repositories.
katalog.lang_qwencoder: Trained for agentic coding: tool calls, patient multi-step runs, honest diffs. MoE with 3B active per token, so it answers fast on a 32-GB machine.
katalog.satz_execore: Our core model — trained on the terminal's own behaviour, tools and rules.
katalog.lang_execore: A fine-tuned 27B that knows this terminal: every built-in tool, the folder rules, the limits — and it reads tool schemas it has never seen. Trained on behaviour, not facts.
katalog.satz_emb_qwen3: The modern compact embedder — strong retrieval, 32k context.
katalog.satz_emb_nomic: The proven all-rounder for local search — small, fast, reliable.
katalog.satz_emb_gemma: Google's small embedder — light, multilingual, quick.
katalog.satz_emb_bgem3: The multilingual heavyweight — a hundred languages, 8k context.
katalog.satz_emb_mxbai: Strong English retrieval in a small file.
katalog.satz_emb_minilm: The tiny classic — instant, and good enough for quick lookups.
